name: versioned_artifacts
description: Versioned file trees with drafts, immutable versions, and an atomic current pointer

tools.name: versioned_artifact
tools.description: VersionedArtifacts toolset master switch — every versioned_artifact_* tool additionally requires its own key

tools.name: versioned_artifact_init
tools.description: Create a new empty artifact; fill it by creating a draft and saving a version

tools.name: versioned_artifact_list
tools.description: List the artifacts you can work on, with their current version and open drafts

tools.name: versioned_artifact_get_current
tools.description: Read which version an artifact currently publishes

tools.name: versioned_artifact_create_draft
tools.description: Create an editable draft from a version and copy it into your workspace

tools.name: versioned_artifact_materialize
tools.description: Copy a draft or a version into your workspace, replacing whatever is there

tools.name: versioned_artifact_save_version
tools.description: Save your workspace copy of a draft as a new immutable version; the draft stays open

tools.name: versioned_artifact_diff
tools.description: Compare a draft's SAVED content against its base, current, or a version

tools.name: versioned_artifact_publish
tools.description: Point an artifact's current at an existing version

tools.name: versioned_artifact_discard_draft
tools.description: Delete a draft without creating a version
